matchingMethod: Candidate name-stem match after stripping the 14-digit filename prefix and .sql suffix. This is not proof of byte-identical SQL, execution, or applied-source identity.

rc424Alias.note: Name-stem candidate match with differing version prefix; prior exact statement comparison must be preserved as separate evidence.

interpretation: Unmatched rows are unresolved source/alias reconciliation, not proof that a migration was not applied. Never rewrite the production ledger or treat filename presence as applied state.
